assessment: This is an important study that examines the role of TFAM, a protein that helps maintain mtDNA, in mtDNA mutator mice. With convincing evidence, the authors have demonstrated that TFAM's counteractive role in mtDNA mutator mice is tissue-specific. The study does a thorough job of assessing the impact of modulating TFAM levels in a polg mutator mouse model of aging. The authors have thoroughly addressed all the points raised during the first round of review.
